what: MercadoLibre runs Latin America's largest online marketplace and its largest fintech business. Mercado Libre sells goods across 18 countries, Mercado Pago handles payments, lending and digital accounts, and Mercado Envíos delivers the parcels.
customers: Shoppers and merchants across Latin America, especially Brazil, Mexico and Argentina, and users of its payment and credit services.
money: marketplace commissions, shipping fees and advertising
payment processing, credit to consumers and merchants, and digital accounts
moat: The largest logistics network in a region where delivery is hard, combined with a payment system most buyers and sellers already use.
risks: Its credit book grows quickly and losses rise when economies weaken
Argentine inflation and currency moves distort reported results
Debt has risen to about $16 billion to fund the credit business
Competition from Amazon and Asian marketplaces is increasing
opportunities: Revenue has grown about 39% a year for three years
Latin American e-commerce and digital payments are far less penetrated than in the US or China
Advertising on the marketplace is high-margin revenue from existing traffic
watch: Credit portfolio growth against non-performing loans, and commerce take rate.
